messages:
maya: Heads up — scheduling a quiet-window TF apply at 23:00 UTC for tenant-fencing + route cleanup. Need module pin, smoke-tests, and a clear rollback path.

deploybot: Scheduled apply window created: 2026-03-30 23:00 UTC. Auto-checks: plan-fingerprint, lockfile, policy-check. Link: https://deploy.internal/runs/0x9f3a

alex: which module exactly? I assume `module.tenant_fence` + `module/route53-cleanup`?

maya: Correct. Plan targets: `-target=module.tenant_fence` then follow-up `-target=module.route53_cleanup`. We'll keep `provider.aws` pinned to v4.28.0 for this run.

sam: Confirming NAT/egress won't be touched? We had a broken egress rule in staging last week.

maya: NAT paths untouched. This is IAM + Route53 TTL/records only. Still, will run connectivity smoke after fence.

alex: Can we freeze merges to `main` for the window? Recommend a temporary branch lock until verification. :lock:

deploybot: Merge lock applied to `main` for window starting 5155554321 -> 5155558000. To override use `deploybot override --reason "urgent" --by ops-lead`.

ops-oncall: I'll watch the window and run post-apply checks. Will be on pager for 3 hours.

maya: Preflight checklist (short):
1) Confirm plan fn fingerprint + outputs diff
2) Pin modules & provider (alex confirmed)
3) Canary: run fence for 2 tenants first (handful of users)
4) Post-apply smoke: auth, DNS resolve, service ping
5) Rollback steps verified

alex: Plan snippet (sanitized):
```
+ module.tenant_fence.aws_iam_role.tenant_api_role
~ aws_route53_record.service-ttl (change) 300 -> 60
```

sam: For canary, recommend running `terraform apply -target=module.tenant_fence -var=\"tenants=[\\\"t-1001\\\",\\\"t-1002\\\"]\"` then validate metrics for 10m.

maya: Agreed. Canary cadence: apply -> 10m validation -> 50% tenants -> full. If any 5xx spike or auth failures -> abort and rollback.

alex: Rollback playbook (short):
- `terraform state pull` to get current state backup
- `terraform apply` using previous state snapshot (restore from s3: s3://tf-state-backups/2026-03-28/)
- Revert Route53 changes: reapply previous record set
- Notify clients and open incident if >5min partial outage

deploybot: Preflight checks passed: plan-hash matches release-notes, lockfile unchanged, no pending provider upgrades. Ready to proceed on `GO` from ops lead.

taylor: Ops lead here — GO for canary. I'll coordinate with SRE for metrics alerting. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Starting canary apply now for tenants t-1001,t-1002. Monitoring DNS RRT, auth latency, and 5xx.

(monitoring) deploybot: Canary apply completed in 42s. No errors. plan-id: 0x9f3a-canary

sam: Quick check — DNS TTL change propagated to our edge nodes, test resolution OK from eu-west-1.

ops-oncall: 10m check green. No auth regressions, 99.99% success for canary users. Proceed to 50%.

maya: Rolling to 50% now. Will stop on any spike >0.5% error rate over baseline.

deploybot: 50% rollout done. plan-id: 0x9f3a-roll50.

alex: Observability note: captured `tfplan` diff + `apply` logs in run: https://deploy.internal/runs/0x9f3a/logs (redacted).

ops-oncall: All green at 50% for 15m. Proceeding to full. Watching DNS propagation, will trigger rollback if any auth errors >0.2%.

maya: Full rollout in progress. Ops-oncall to call rollback if issues.

deploybot: Full apply complete. No errors. Final plan-hash: 0x9f3a-final.

ops-oncall: Post-apply checks done. Services healthy. Releasing merge lock in 10m. Good job everyone. :party-parrot:

maya: Notes for release log: provider pinned v4.28.0, targeted apply order (fence -> route53), canary steps, rollback snapshot s3://tf-state-backups/2026-03-28/. I'll add to release notes.

alex: Small follow-up: create an automation to capture `state pull` snapshot before targeted applies next time.

maya: Agreed — ticketing that now. Thanks all.
